correctness.rationale: Let X=cos2π(x−a),Y=cos2π(y−b). The zero-mean first-band polynomial H=XY+(X+Y)/2 satisfies H≤0 wherever X≤−1/3 or Y≤−1/3 and vanishes in that complement exactly at (-1,-1),(-1/3,1),(1,-1/3). A maximal empty square at or beyond r*=acos(-1/3)/(2π) thus confines the support, by positivity and zero integral, to five torus sites. The first sine moments force opposite contacts equal; mass and coordinate cosine moments then force mass 1/4 at the antipode and 3/16 at four contacts. Their complex Fourier moments vanish at all eight nonzero frequencies; strict larger holes contradict the forced contact distances. Independently recomputed all nine first-band moments of the five-atom measure with maximal complex residual 5.6e-17. This is not enumeration over all positive measures.
